result:
All 25 call sites are wired across the 10 services that needed them. The implementation is complete:

- **`src/types/billing.ts`** — added `WorkspaceLockReason` and `BillingSummary.lockReason`.
- **`src/types/organization.ts`** — added `OrganizationSummary.lockReason`.
- **`src/lib/billing-lock.ts`** (new) — `WorkspaceLockedError` and the pure `lockReasonFor` rule.
- **`src/server/services/billing-service.ts`** — `assertWorkspaceWritable`, and `getBillingSummary` now reports `lockReason`; `changePlan`/`updateSeats`/`cancelSubscription`/deletion stay unguarded.
- **`src/lib/errors.ts`** — `toAppError`/`isDomainError` recognize `WorkspaceLockedError` → `plan_limit_exceeded` with `meta.reason`.
- Lock checks inserted immediately after the permission check in every guarded write: issues (`issue-service.ts`), comments (`comment-service.ts`), projects (`project-service.ts`), labels (`label-service.ts`), attachments (`attachment-service.ts`), membership (`member-service.ts`), invitations including accept-by-token (`invitation-service.ts`), org settings (`organization-service.ts`, not delete), feature-flag overrides (`feature-flag-service.ts`), and webhooks (`webhook-service.ts`).
- Notification housekeeping, billing writes, workspace deletion, and all background jobs (they call repositories/other services directly, not the guarded entry points) remain untouched, per spec.

Verified with `tsc --noEmit` (clean) and the full test suite (`vitest run`: 73 files, 617 tests, all passing) — no existing test encoded behavior this change alters, so none needed updating.
